name: Pylon Wars
description: The war rages on, each side clings to the bright light and power of their Pylons constantly searching to control more of them; Always attacking those who do the same.

name: Keydai-Mon
description: Shape your team of loyal guardian creatures called Keydai-Mon and best your peers in Real-Time Strategy Battles. Befriend and care for more and more Keydai-Mon as you learn how to synergize their powerful abilities and transformations together. Journey across the land to find a way to save your town from the Black Root infection. Trust that with your Keydai-Mon at your side, anything is possible.
